# Azure Cloud Operations & Observability Platform

**Project 2 — Cloud Operations and Observability**

Use the tabs to switch between operational health and diagnostics, portfolio analytics and governance.

**Monitoring window:** Last 4 days (96 hours).

_Note: Response-time KPIs are temporarily excluded from the KQL panels while Application Insights duration telemetry is investigated. They are not being reported as zero._

content.query:
let summary = requests
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| summarize
    TotalRequests = count(),
    FailedRequests = countif(success == false),
    ServerErrors = countif(toint(resultCode) between (500 .. 599));
union
(
    summary
    | project Title = "Total Requests",
              Metric = todouble(TotalRequests),
              SubTitle = "Last 4 days"
),
(
    summary
    | project Title = "Failed Requests",
              Metric = todouble(FailedRequests),
              SubTitle = "All failed requests"
),
(
    summary
    | project Title = "Failure Rate",
              Metric = iff(TotalRequests == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * todouble(FailedRequests) / todouble(TotalRequests), 2)),
              SubTitle = "Percent of requests"
),
(
    summary
    | project Title = "HTTP 5xx Errors",
              Metric = todouble(ServerErrors),
              SubTitle = "Server errors"
),
(
    summary
    | project Title = "HTTP 5xx Rate",
              Metric = iff(TotalRequests == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * todouble(ServerErrors) / todouble(TotalRequests), 2)),
              SubTitle = "Percent of requests"
)
content.title: API Health — Request & Failure KPIs (Last 4 Days)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    FailedRequests = countif(success == false),
    ServerErrors = countif(toint(resultCode) between (500 .. 599))
    by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Request Volume & Failures — Hourly Trend

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    FailedRequests = countif(success == false),
    ServerErrors = countif(toint(resultCode) between (500 .. 599))
    by Operation = name
| extend FailureRatePct = iff(Requests == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * todouble(FailedRequests) / todouble(Requests), 2))
| project Operation, Requests, FailedRequests, ServerErrors, FailureRatePct
| order by Requests desc
| take 8
content.title: API Operation Health — Last 4 Days

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| where success == false or toint(resultCode) between (500 .. 599)
| project
    Timestamp = timestamp,
    Operation = name,
    ResultCode = resultCode,
    Success = success,
    Url = url,
    OperationId = operation_Id
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 10
content.title: Recent API Failures — Last 4 Days

content.query:
availabilityResults
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| summarize
    TotalTests = count(),
    SuccessfulTests = countif(success == true),
    FailedTests = countif(success == false),
    AvailabilityPct = round(100.0 * countif(success == true) / count(), 2)
    by name, location
| order by name asc
content.title: Availability Test Results — Last 4 Days

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| summarize
    ExceptionCount = count(),
    FirstSeen = min(timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(timestamp),
    SampleMessage = take_any(iff(isempty(outerMessage), innermostMessage, outerMessage)),
    SampleOperation = take_any(operation_Name)
    by type
| project
    ExceptionType = type,
    ExceptionCount,
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    SampleOperation,
    SampleMessage
| order by ExceptionCount desc
content.title: Exception Details — Last 4 Days

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp >= ago(4d)
| summarize Exceptions = count() by bin(timestamp, 6h), type
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Exception Trend — Last 4 Days

Resources
| where subscriptionId == '8bb846b6-1057-42bb-a02a-7a64e6a34178'
| where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-portfolio'
| project name, type, location, kind
| order by type asc
content.title: Azure Resource Inventory

content.query:
Resources
| where subscriptionId == '8bb846b6-1057-42bb-a02a-7a64e6a34178'
| where resourceGroup =~ 'rg-portfolio'
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.insights/scheduledqueryrules',
    'microsoft.insights/metricalerts',
    'microsoft.insights/actiongroups',
    'microsoft.insights/webtests'
)
| extend Enabled = tostring(properties.enabled)
| project name, type, location, Enabled
| order by type asc
content.title: Monitoring Rules and Health Checks
